full_page.content:
1935, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 78 Dec. 16 Nancy Ann Farrand - 17 mo. - serious stomach trouble - nothing re- tained.
Mary O'Rourk Cahill - 25 .....
O. MacDuvall - graduate from (Monroe) asks for prayers that she have courage to make her confession - fears loss of mind - has been away for about a year.
Peter LaDuc - 36 - of Toledo - paralysed since May 24th - here To-day & enrolled - not able to stand alone .... in mad condition ....
F1. Phillips - 63 - cheap room - must leave pres't tomorrow.
Martha Grucz - 24 - gave birth to little baby about a month ago. Drs. wonder that she is still living.
Mary Johnson - 40 - operation on .. fears cancer of breast.
Helen Conchuyt - 4 - infant. Para. - Mother n.c. Drs. ...
Rose Nagel - Fr. Nagel' sister - given up as hopeless cancer of colen .. . Enrolled.
Page 79 Dec. 20th E'd McCullen - 32 - Ostemelitis ... 4 operations - fears if another is taken will not be able to walk at all. Enrolled To-day. - Was in taxie business - got away from practicing religion - not to confession in years promises to go .... now tells me not a Catholic - Lutheran
Tho's Ciolli - 40 - has three children - oldest 8 - wants some one to care children & house while he works - will pay. . and give home .... 3158 Garfield Ave. City.
Peter D. Manning - 9 - almost deaf from mastoids as little baby ..... Enrolled To-night - perpet ....
Mary Cavanaugh - 74 - stomach tro
21 Ted. Kfara - 17 - June 10, 1933 paralyzed, lost speech ever since. - folk not pract'ing their religion - unable to keep up payments ... etc etc - boy never baptized. - Enrolled To-night promises made to take instructions & be baptized etc.
